summary: SCOPED CLAIM — tools/governor/footer.mjs ONLY, the renderer and degradation ladder of the governor footer. Scoped deliberately to match the diff; the sampler half was reviewed separately and approved, and the footer's test file is a separate packet. CONTEXT. BUILD-018 built a session governor that enforced 0 of its 4 intended rules and is being torn down surgically rather than reverted. footer.mjs SURVIVES. The footer is the ONLY governor output that reaches the operator on the claude.ai web and Android clients, where the terminal statusLine never runs, which is why it exists and why its honesty matters more than its coverage. WHAT THIS DIFF DOES. (1) footer.mjs drops its programme-state dependency, one of the two surgical decouplings in the teardown. (2) `next:` becomes a CALLER-SUPPLIED INPUT defaulting to UNSET: nextModelFor and all nine UNSET_REASON members are deleted, because nothing can emit them once their producer is gone. It now carries MODEL and EFFORT together, as in 'Opus/high', with both vocabularies frozen as literals that the renderer AND the anchored FOOTER_RE both derive from, so the two cannot drift apart. (3) HANDBACK_CODES is byte-identical to a989e68 — it is the frozen mirror of the constitution's seven interruption codes, so an edit there is a breaking change to a governing document, not a code edit. (4) The context indicator is re-sourced from the session transcript so a reading reaches the operator on clients where statusLine never runs. THE GOVERNING RULE FOR THE INDICATOR, ruled by the operator 2026-08-02 and superseding the earlier decision: accept a TRUE ABSOLUTE COUNT on web and mobile; never use a static declared window; never infer a denominator from another session; render a PERCENTAGE ONLY when the current session supplies an authoritative window size. A wrong percentage is strictly worse than no percentage — a prior defect rendered a live session at 46% of a borrowed window when its true figure was 9%, and would have crossed the RED threshold at roughly a fifth of real capacity, advising the operator to discard a healthy context. WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED: nothing in this diff has run in CI, all counts are from one Windows machine; tools/governor/continuity.mjs and continuity-derive.mjs have NO TESTS AT ALL, zero coverage rather than merely unproven wiring; worktree-guard.mjs survives as a file but is INERT, returning defer for every guarded tool once no active programme-state exists — reported deliberately and NOT repaired, because building a replacement guard is the regrowth this reset exists to cut; and a known unfixed hazard remains where deriveFooterFields, handed an unwrapped sample, degrades to BLIND indistinguishably from genuine telemetry loss — the recommended remedy is recorded and out of the current surface. All evidence behind this is builder self-test plus the orchestrator's own re-run. It is NOT independent review, which is what you are being asked for.
brief_excerpt:
Judge this diff against these acceptance criteria and ONLY these. C4 and D1-D6 were written BEFORE the diff existed.

SCOPE: this packet contains tools/governor/footer.mjs ONLY. Three notes so a scope artefact is not mistaken for a defect. (1) Rows about any other file are OUT OF SCOPE — mark them not_applicable, never blocked, and do not let the absence of other files reduce confidence in the rows below. (2) The tests for this module live in tools/governor/footer.test.mjs, which is a SEPARATE packet; do not report tests as missing from this one. (3) tools/governor/sampler.mjs, which supplies the sample, was reviewed under its own claim and approved; the denominator rules are ITS responsibility, not this file's.

C4. footer.mjs no longer imports programme-state.mjs.
D1. `next:` is a caller-supplied input defaulting to UNSET. nextModelFor and the programme-shaped UNSET_REASON members are deleted, not merely unused.
D2. The grammar is MODEL '/' EFFORT (e.g. Opus/high), with UNSET still bare. BOTH vocabularies must be frozen literals that the renderer and FOOTER_RE derive from, so a change in one cannot drift from the other. Effort vocabulary is low|medium|high|xhigh|max.
D3. parseFooter(renderFooter(x)) round-trip identity holds.
D4. HANDBACK_CODES is UNCHANGED — seven members, exact spelling. The constitution names it as the frozen mirror of the seven interruption codes, so any edit is a breaking change rather than an edit. HIGHEST SEVERITY ROW: check the member names character by character.
D6. An absolute token count is rendered when only the numerator is known; a percentage ONLY when both numerator and denominator are known. A fabricated percentage is a defect; a true absolute number is not.

Z1. INV-1, the invariant this module exists for: BLIND must never render as GREEN. Verify no path through the ladder can reach a graded state from unreadable, stale, foreign or absent telemetry. This is the one that matters most — the module's entire purpose is that an absent governor must not be indistinguishable from a healthy one.
Z2. The ladder must never THROW. A footer that cannot be computed must still be a grammatical footer, because an absent line and a healthy line look identical to a reader.
Z3. Session-mismatch must outrank staleness, so a sample that is both stale AND from another session reports the mismatch. Never rendering another session's numbers is the stronger statement.

ADVERSARIAL ROWS — answer even if every row above passes:
W1. Find any input for which the ladder renders a GRADED state (GREEN/AMBER/RED) that the telemetry does not support. Name it concretely.
W2. Can renderFooter be made to emit a line that parseFooter cannot parse, or that parses to different values? Consider boundary numbers, rounding, and the approximate marker.
W3. Is there any path where a real percentage is rendered from a denominator the sample did not authoritatively carry?
W4. The grammar is anchored by a regex. Can any permitted field value break the separator grammar or make the line ambiguous to the parser?

OUT OF SCOPE - do not report as defects: which modules were kept or deleted (the operator's decision, not a code question); prose, naming or comment-style preference; the deliberate choice that a token count WITHOUT a denominator yields state BLIND rather than a grade — that is the ruled behaviour, not an oversight, because a count cannot be classified without a window; the absence of malicious-handler hardening, since this estate's bar is correctness, accidental leak, availability and audit for a first-party personal system, not a hostile-input service; the lack of CI execution, the zero coverage of continuity.mjs, and the inert worktree-guard.mjs, all disclosed above and already recorded.
